selection_rule: minimize training-route losses versus matched same-start target-only GP-UCB
maximize training equal-route mean AUC delta
maximize the worst training-route AUC delta
minimize the number of training routes switched to target-only GP
prefer the lower-parameter controller when behavior is tied
prefer the earlier handoff when all prior criteria are tied
protocol.claim_policy: The controller is selected using only the 11 training routes and then evaluated on six route-disjoint trajectories. All trajectories are previously completed retrospective replays, so this is a leakage-controlled development audit rather than prospective or external validation.
